query: INSERT INTO manifestation_external_ratings (manifestation_id, source, rating, rating_scale, review_count, fetched_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, now()) ON CONFLICT (manifestation_id, source) DO UPDATE SET rating = EXCLUDED.rating, rating_scale = EXCLUDED.rating_scale, review_count = EXCLUDED.review_count, fetched_at = now()
